tips.title: Assembling Trumpeter Multi-Part Gun Barrels
tips.text: For Trumpeter's multi-part gun barrels, start by painting the individual parts. Align them dry, then use super glue (CA) for a strong bond. Apply a small amount to the mating surfaces, use tweezers to hold the parts together, and allow 15 seconds for initial bond. Then clamp gently and let cure for 60 seconds.

tips.title: Using Jigs for AFV Club Wing Alignment
tips.text: When assembling AFV Club kits with multi-part wings, use a jig for precise alignment. Cut two pieces of cardboard, shape them to fit the wing roots, and slot them together. Apply Tamiya Extra Thin Cement to one side of the root, align the wing halves on the jig, clamp gently, and let cure for 30 minutes.

tips.title: Installing Eduard Photo-Etch Parts
tips.text: For Eduard photo-etch parts, use a dedicated bending tool to shape them carefully. Apply a small amount of CA glue to the attachment point on the kit, immediately place the photo-etch part, and let cure for 15 seconds. Use tweezers to hold it in place until fully cured. Seal any gaps with Vallejo Plastic Putty.

tips.title: Working with Clear Prop Models Resin Conversion Kits
tips.text: With Clear Prop Models resin conversion kits, use a new X-Acto blade to remove the casting block. Carefully clean up the parts with a needle file and 400 grit sandpaper. For tricky parts, use a dental pick to remove any remaining resin. Glue with CA, clipping the excess after curing.

tips.title: Assembling Individual Track Links vs. Vinyl vs. Workable
tips.text: For individual track links, use CA glue for each link, allowing 15 seconds cure time between links. For vinyl tracks, cut the links apart, align, and use CA glue for a few links at a time, clipping excess after curing. For workable tracks, simply cut and align, no glue needed. Always dry-fit first, then cement.
